# NDINA Gallery

> NDINA Gallery is an international fine art gallery, registered in Hong Kong and rooted in Fiji, representing Fijian contemporary artists for global audiences. Founder and Gallery Director: Dexter Cohen Bohn. Contact: admin@ndina.gallery

NDINA Gallery represents Mason James Lee, Josaia Waqabaca McNamara and Anare Somumu, and curates Artwaka, a voyaging event series combining contemporary Oceanic art with kava-talanoa. Content on this site may be read, quoted and cited with attribution to NDINA Gallery and a link to the source page.
